facades.name: Weesperplein wing, upper storeys
facades.note: From the narrow window column (photo x 265) to the south end of the wing (x 1000): per upper storey one narrow window and eight axes 1.93 m apart, six storeys over the tall ground floor. The round stair windows (x 40-120) and the ground floor (tall windows, the Weesperplein 11 door, the narrow window) are left out of the window: the round windows sit between storey levels and the ground floor mixes three heights.

facades.name: canal wing, grey tiled block
facades.note: Grey block between the brick part (photo x 680) and the glass corner (x 1310): eight rows, each one narrow window at its east end and four wide windows; the ground row has small low windows on the same axes. alongM is measured from the model's east silhouette edge (the east block, a = 56 m).
